name: vale-apology
description: One-time narrative beat: Sergeant Vale was squatting in Akerson's Embassy unit (Unit 2A) while she got back on her feet. The first time Akerson shares a room with her after she's found her own place, she apologises, thanks him, presses ₵200 into his hand, and finally moves out to her own home (Unit 3B). Fires once, ever — guarded by a persistent world flag.
